findings.reason: each arm's starting route and solver policy must be stated per arm or the bracket, the control and the repair arm measure different states.
findings.text: §2(1) brackets the largest perturbation at which the solve "still qualifies" starting from the stored coefficients and the stored flux map, but the cited record's stored-field solve is unqualified at 4.864113698736961e-10 against the unchanged 1e-10 limit (`efit-comparison.html:1593-1603`), and the 5.307643379157493e-16 qualification exists only in a continuation seeded by the banked terminal state with internal stopping tolerance 1e-12, Newton budget 40 and outer budget 64 (`efit-comparison.html:1764-1775`), so at zero perturbation §2 has no qualifying point to bracket from, while §1(2) declares that same unperturbed state a base-revision positive control and §3(1) requires it to be repaired — one measurement cannot be both a control and a base-red arm

findings.reason: §2 and §3 cannot name the state they measure until §1 records the perturbed coefficients, their coordinate and their sign.
findings.text: §2(1), §2(3) and §3(1) all key off "the displaced coefficients/direction at which §1 recorded the refusal", but §1's done-when (`:72-79`) requires no record of the perturbed coefficient vector, and the cited record states the MAST-U refusal was a single-coordinate lower central-difference probe (`_, lower = self._evaluate(coefficients - direction, seed)`, `efit-comparison.html:1913-1920`) whose "response-column identity" is unavailable (`efit-comparison.html:1938-1940`), so the displacement is neither recorded nor recoverable from the stored inputs §1 admits, and "the profile-coefficient direction the inverse class perturbs" is not a direction the class has (`magnetics_fit.py:364-369` probes each coordinate separately, then takes one combined correction)

findings.reason: a done-when clause that passes on unfixed code proves nothing and should be dropped or replaced by a displacement shown red at base.
findings.text: §3(1)'s arm at "the same amount in the opposite step" is green at the base revision: the central-difference construction evaluated `coefficients + direction` and returned successfully before the `coefficients - direction` evaluation raised (`efit-comparison.html:1913-1920`), and the failed side is recorded as "Refused lower response perturbation" with residual 0.0001237999574577207 (`efit-comparison.html:1926`), so the opposite arm already qualifies at base and its repair has no endpoint

findings.reason: the quantity cannot fail and must be replaced by one the trace can vary in, or the arm reduced to the terminal reason and residual.
findings.text: §2(2) asks for "the outer iteration at which qualification is first lost" for TCV and ITER, but the cited record has both solves unqualified from their first recorded trip (TCV stored-field residual 0.030364200526436996, `efit-comparison.html:1651`; ITER residual non-finite with no admitted axis, `efit-comparison.html:1733-1737`), so no qualifying iteration exists from which qualification can be lost and the reported value is fixed at "none"/zero whatever the solve does

findings.reason: §3's scope for two of its three cases cannot be decided from §2's output.
findings.text: §2(3) defines Reached as "the displaced state at which §1 recorded the refusal qualifies … when approached from the stored state through intermediate solves", yet for TCV and ITER §1 records the refusal at the stored coefficients themselves (zero displacement; §1(1), `efit-comparison.html:1651`, `1932-1935`), so "approached from the stored state" is a sequence from a state to itself, and the verdict that decides whether §3 owes those two cases a repair is undefined

findings.reason: a stated search set is needed before the verdict bounds §3's work.
findings.text: "Not reached: no sequence tried qualifies" states no bound on the sequence (number of intermediate solves, step size, ordering), so the verdict records how hard the worker tried rather than a property of the case; combined with §3's "a case §2 marks as not reached is not forced", the plan permits two of three cases to be parked on an arm that cannot fail
